material_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Exterior Masonry
material_systems.description: Low-viscosity chalk-binding conditioner primer that penetrates and binds loose chalk residue on previously painted masonry surfaces. MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING regardless of quality tier. Full surface application required. Chalking on masonry is less common than on fiber cement but occurs on smooth-painted block and concrete surfaces exposed to UV. Higher material consumption on rough textures due to chalk deposits in surface valleys.

products.notes: MANDATORY for chalking masonry. Full surface application. Penetrates and binds residual chalk layer. Apply after power wash and 48-hr dry time.

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC primer. Same product family as SYS_EXT_FCRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND. Coverage rate adjusted for masonry texture — rough masonry absorbs more than flat fiber cement.

material_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Masonry Repaint
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior stain-blocking primer for previously painted masonry surfaces where existing paint has failed or peeled. Applied over intact painted areas surrounding bare spots. Spot prime when localized failure; full prime on SS_EXT_PEELING. Not used on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (skip prime) or SS_EXT_CHALKING (use chalk-binding instead).

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Primer
products.notes: Stain-blocking adhesion primer for previously painted masonry. Applied over intact painted areas. Bare masonry spots get alkali-resistant primer instead.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime feathered areas and surrounding paint; full prime if widespread
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: full surface prime after heavy scrape/power wash to sound substrate

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Alkali-resistant acrylic masonry primer for exposed bare masonry areas where paint has failed or peeled, revealing cementitious substrate at pH 12-13. MANDATORY on all exposed bare masonry. In RP context, applied as spot primer on exposed bare areas — not full surface unless extensive failure. Reuses NC system unchanged.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec Masonry & Stucco Primer
products.notes: MANDATORY on exposed bare masonry (pH 12-13). Standard acrylic primer NOT suitable. Spot prime in RP. Same product as NC — chemistry is substrate-driven.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime exposed bare masonry at failure points
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: spot prime all exposed bare masonry; full prime if extensive bare exposure

material_systems.notes: Reuse NC system. Coverage profile from NC applies to RP bare masonry areas.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior latex for masonry wall field. Standard finish for QT2/QT3. 10-20 perms breathability. QT2: 1 coat. QT3: 2 coats. Reuse NC system.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Masonry Coating
products.notes: Standard acrylic masonry finish. Previously painted surface has slightly higher coverage than bare masonry (less absorption).

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Premium 100% acrylic (SW Emerald, BM Aura) for QT4. 2 coats with interstage inspection. Reuse NC system.

products.notes: Premium acrylic. Raking light inspection between coats at QT4.

material_systems.name: Elastomeric Coating for Masonry (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Elastomeric coating: 20-30 mils DFT, 300-500% elongation, crack-bridging. QT3/QT4 only. 2 coats mandatory. NOT on brick (moisture trap). NOT on limestone. CMU and concrete substrates only. Flat sheen only. Requires moisture source assessment. Reuse NC system.

products.notes: 2 coats mandatory. NOT on brick or limestone. RP-specific: do not apply over failing previous elastomeric — must fully remove failed coat first.

material_systems.cleanup: Water. Heavy wash required — elastomeric is thick.
material_systems.notes: Reuse NC system. RP note: verify previous coating is not failing elastomeric before applying.

ITM_MASONRY_WALL.notes: Chalk-binding primer on masonry. Lower coverage than standard primer due to chalk absorption. Rough texture further reduces coverage.

coverage_profiles.notes: Coverage adjusted for masonry texture. Rough split-face CMU absorbs significantly more chalk-binding primer.

ITM_MASONRY_WALL.notes: Acrylic stain-block on previously painted masonry. Higher coverage than bare masonry (existing paint reduces absorption).
Alkali-resistant primer on bare masonry. Heavy absorption on porous bare substrate. In RP context, spot application so gallon goes further overall.
Acrylic finish on masonry. RP coverage slightly higher than NC (existing paint reduces absorption). Texture modifier applies.
Elastomeric coating — very low coverage per gallon (20-30 mils DFT). Thick body, high material cost per SF.

compatibility_rules.description: No oil-based products on masonry — saponification risk from alkaline substrate
Alkali-resistant primer MANDATORY on all exposed bare masonry in RP
compatibility_rules.notes: pH 12-13 bare masonry requires alkali resistance. Standard acrylic primer NOT suitable.
Cannot skip chalk-binding step — topcoat adhesion failure guaranteed without it.

compatibility_rules.description: Elastomeric coating NOT on brick or limestone
compatibility_rules.notes: Elastomeric traps moisture in brick (spalling risk) and is incompatible with limestone.

compatibility_rules.description: Elastomeric QT3+ only — not available at QT2
compatibility_rules.notes: Elastomeric requires 2-coat minimum and moisture assessment — not suitable for economy tier.

compatibility_rules.description: No acid cleaning on limestone — use phosphoric acid or TSP
compatibility_rules.notes: Muriatic acid dissolves limestone. Phosphoric acid or TSP for efflorescence treatment.
MC > 12% = no coating until dry. Masonry holds moisture longer than other substrates.

compatibility_rules.description: Spray-only PROHIBITED on masonry — backroll mandatory
compatibility_rules.notes: Porous masonry requires backroll for continuous DFT.

compatibility_rules.description: Do not apply elastomeric over failing previous elastomeric
compatibility_rules.notes: RP-SPECIFIC: Failing elastomeric must be fully removed before re-application.

compatibility_rules.description: Active/recurring efflorescence = STOP WORK until moisture source resolved
compatibility_rules.notes: Dormant efflorescence can be treated. Active/recurring indicates unresolved moisture source.
